title: Your life in Bristol: discover the city at the heart of our university
description:
Find out why Bristol is in the top ten UK cities to be a student.

What sets Bristol apart?

Bristol is known for its creativity, inclusivity and independent spirit. The city has a strong sense of community, making it a welcoming and friendly place to live. With so much to do and explore, Bristol truly has something to offer everyone.

The Clifton campus is in the heart of the city, perfectly located for you to explore between classes.

Our city’s unique, vibrant atmosphere is best experienced firsthand. But if you live and study in Bristol, it might feel something like this.
